new_page.title: Schools in Surrey, BC | Full List by Level | Jared Gibbons
new_page.description: Browse 168 public and independent schools with a Surrey address, grouped by level with street addresses. From the BC Ministry of Education and Child Care list

blocks.text: The BC Ministry of Education and Child Care school list shows 168 schools with a Surrey street address: 137 public schools and 31 independent schools. It also shows 9 college and university campuses. In that list, 15 schools marked as offering French Immersion, 1 Francophone school run by the Conseil scolaire francophone, 3 alternate programs and 4 online schools.

Public schools here are run by School District 36 (Surrey) and School District 93 (Conseil scolaire francophone). Count by district: School District 36 (Surrey): 136, School District 93 (Conseil scolaire francophone): 1.
Alternate programs, continuing education centres and online schools that have a street address sit under "other public schools and programs"; the level of every school is read from its name.

Public secondary schools with a Surrey address: Clayton Heights Secondary, Earl Marriott Secondary, Elgin Park Secondary, Enver Creek Secondary, Fleetwood Park Secondary, Frank Hurt Secondary, Fraser Heights Secondary and Grandview Heights Secondary and 14 more.

The Ministry file marks these Surrey schools as offering French Immersion: Crescent Park Elementary, Earl Marriott Secondary, Jessie Lee Elementary, K B Woodward Elementary, Kwantlen Park Secondary, Laronde Elementary, Martha Currie Elementary, Pacific Heights Elementary, Sikh Academy and Simon Cunningham Elementary and 5 more.

Independent schools listed for Surrey include Al-Mustafa School, Anchor Point Montessori, Bibleway Christian Academy, Cloverdale Catholic School, Cornerstone Montessori School and Crescent Heights Academy and 25 more.
Before an offer, ask the district which school serves the exact street address.
The Surrey school district publishes its catchments only as an interactive map, not as a list of streets. Use the district's own page to check an address:
Surrey school district catchments and school finder
The Conseil scolaire francophone publishes its attendance zones (zones de fréquentation) on its own site:
Conseil scolaire francophone attendance zones

The district's own school pages also list French Immersion at Crescent Park Elementary, Earl Marriott Secondary, Jessie Lee Elementary, K B Woodward Elementary, Kwantlen Park Secondary, Laronde Elementary, Martha Currie Elementary, Pacific Heights Elementary, Simon Cunningham Elementary, Snokomish Elementary, Sunrise Ridge Elementary, and École Panorama Ridge Secondary and 2 more, where the Ministry file flag reads No. Confirm the program with the school before relying on either.
The list covers the whole city, so schools in South Surrey, Cloverdale, Newton, Fleetwood and Guildford are in it because they carry Surrey addresses.

blocks.text: What homes sold for near Surrey schools

For 82 of these schools there are enough sales to show what homes sold for nearby. Between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026, the middle price of all homes sold within the radius shown ran from $430,875 near Forsyth Road Elementary to $1,599,800 near Colebrook Elementary. The figures are by distance from the school, not by catchment, and a house and a townhome sell at very different prices, so compare like with like. A school's own page has the full table with condos, days to sell and the share of sales over the list price.

faq.q: How many schools are in Surrey, BC?
faq.a: The BC Ministry of Education and Child Care list shows 168 schools with a Surrey street address: 137 public schools and 31 independent schools. The count includes alternate programs and online schools that have a street address.
Public schools with a Surrey address are run by School District 36 (Surrey) and School District 93 (Conseil scolaire francophone).

faq.q: How do I find the catchment school for a Surrey address?
faq.a: Ask School District 36 (Surrey) and School District 93 (Conseil scolaire francophone) to confirm it for the exact street address.

faq.q: Can I book a private showing with Jared?
faq.a: Yes. Jared Gibbons, REALTOR® with Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, books private showings across the Fraser Valley and Metro Vancouver. Call or text 604-928-1361, or use the contact form on this site.
